title: feat(core): enforce strict AST types and group table edit history
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Refactor AST node typings to strictly use `mdast`'s `Node` (P0 TS strict coverage), implement CM6 history grouping for table edits (P1), and expose `MathPluginOptions` for Katex fallback control. / 移除了底层的 `any` 类型声明以实现严格类型覆盖，通过事务注解实现了表格编辑的历史记录聚合，并为数学插件提供了完善的配置透传与错误降级功能。

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: HR Evaluation Task
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): 
  - **P0**: TS strict coverage (Removed `any` in Widget API and Table AST parsers).
  - **P1**: Undo/Redo grouping (Table edit aggregation).
- OpenSpec change: N/A

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/core`:
  - Updated `WidgetDefinition` to use strict `Node` (mdast) instead of `any`.
  - Replaced unsafe `as any` casting in `live-preview-table.ts` with explicit `EditableTableWidget` and `mdast.Parent` type guards.
  - Injected `Transaction.userEvent.of("nexus.table-edit")` into table `v.dispatch` calls to group table edits into single undo/redo steps.
- `packages/plugin-*`:
  - `plugin-math`: Exported `MathPluginOptions` containing `katexOptions` and `errorOnInvalid`, allowing consumers to override the native KaTeX error rendering with a smooth Markdown source fallback.
- `apps/electron-demo`: N/A
- `openspec/`: N/A

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：
  - `packages/core/test/live-preview-table.test.ts`: Added tests for `extractCellText` deep nesting (`Link > Image`) and `isCellMediaOnly` discrimination.
  - `packages/plugin-math/test/index.test.ts`: Added fallback behavior tests for `errorOnInvalid` using `vi.mock("katex")`.
- [ ] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [ ] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will be prompted automatically by the CLA bot / 首次贡献者按 CLA 机器人提示签署
- [x] **AI disclosure**: the functional code in this PR is **not** primarily generated by AI. AI assistance, if any, is described below.
      AI-assisted notes / AI 使用说明：Used AI as a pair-programmer for codebase analysis, strict type narrowing, and unit test generation, as permitted by the evaluation guidelines.
- [ ] **New dependencies** (if any) listed with license & rationale (none if blank):
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`) / 未提交构建产物
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed / 无敏感信息

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits / 标题遵循 Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — 改了公共 API 已同步 README 与类型
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → walked through the 12 Table Widget rules in CLAUDE.md / 已核对 12 条表格规则
- [ ] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked / 新 capability 或破坏性变更已附 OpenSpec
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4) / 改动符合 GOVERNANCE.md §4 的项目范围
